A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Selective Rotary Position Embedding and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–B. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic-task experiments and language-model evaluations in Section 4, including Figures 5–7 and Tables 1–3, with experimental details in Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains the original synthetic-task and language-model results in Section 4, Figures 5–7 and Tables 1–3, together with Appendix B experimental details.

M1.justification: The Selective RoPE procedure, input-dependent rotations, gating components and implementation choices in Sections 3.3–4.1 are unchanged. Figure 4 retains the same pseudocode.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MAD, MQAR, copying and state-tracking tasks, FineWeb training data and downstream evaluations in Table 3. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The same NoPE and RoPE alternatives participate in corresponding experiments. The MQAR comparator set and the FoX, GLA and Gated DeltaNet comparison blocks in Table 3 are unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same data sizes, sequence lengths, learning-rate sweeps, metrics, model configurations and training budgets, including the 370M/10B-token and 1.3B/26B-token language-model settings.

E4.justification: The MAD component ablations in Table 1, language-model ablations in Table 2, and copying/state-tracking length-extrapolation analyses in Figures 5 and 7 retain identical evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain copying confidence intervals in Figure 5, five listed state-tracking seeds in Table 6, and copying seed 42 in Table 7. No statistical procedure or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical result entries and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains Selective RoPE average accuracies of 47.1 for GLA 370M and 54.6 for GLA 1.3B under the same settings.

T1.justification: After Equation (7), v3 replaces conjugate-transpose H with transpose ⊤ in two expressions involving real-valued matrices and vectors. These operators are equivalent there. Theorems, assumptions and Appendix A derivations and proofs are otherwise unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same rotation-and-decay rationale, Selective RoPE contribution, and claims concerning recall, expressivity and language modeling.

C2.justification: The model-dependent perplexity/accuracy interpretation in Section 4.3 and future-work qualifications in Section 6 are unchanged. Explanations involving spectral leakage, gating and channel mixing are also retained.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures in Section 4.1 and Appendix B are unchanged. The implementation link and other technical resource destinations are retained.

R1.justification: The cited research and its positioning are unchanged. New standalone proceedings records consolidate venue/editor information previously repeated within existing references; they do not introduce new research comparisons.

P1.justification: v3 adds the ICLR 2026 publication header, updates the arXiv version/date, reformats bibliography entries through proceedings cross-references, and standardizes two transpose symbols. The narrative and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–7 retain their content, captions and placement. Visual changes are limited to the running header, bibliography reflow and small text-spacing changes near Equation (7).

improvement.justification: The scientific arguments, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and appendix content are unchanged. The conference header and bibliography formatting are presentation updates, while the transpose substitutions after Equation (7) preserve mathematical meaning. These edits do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
